name: Dynamics 365 Business Central
summary: Business Central is Microsoft's accounting and ERP product for growing companies, priced per user per month and paid yearly. Essentials costs $80 and Premium $110 per user, and Team Members at $8 are limited users. Bank statements import as files or through the Envestnet Yodlee feed service, and North American installs also have a separate check-and-deposit worksheet without file import.

facts.text: To import bank statements as bank feeds, an administrator must set up the Envestnet Yodlee Bank Feed service and link bank accounts. CSV statement files can be imported without it.
The North American version also offers a Bank Rec. Worksheet that suits checks and deposits but does not import bank statement files.
Account categories define the layout of the financial statements, and users with a Team Member license cannot edit the chart of accounts.
The pricing page offers a free 30-day trial and says listed prices are for information only, with the actual price shown at checkout.

hiddenCosts: Every full user needs an Essentials or Premium license, so a five-person finance team pays at least $400 a month before any Team Members.
Bank feeds need the Envestnet Yodlee service to be set up, and the pricing page says the actual price is confirmed at checkout.
